en.title: First iOS Runtime host for 2D quad scenes
en.body: A JavaScriptCore and Metal sample uses the Rust project-frame decoder to render the existing 40-card scene. Mac builds produce separate simulator and unsigned device applications. The verification receipt distinguishes simulator Metal availability from physical iPhone testing.

zh.title: iOS Runtime 首次接入 2D 四边形场景
zh.body: JavaScriptCore 和 Metal 宿主通过 Rust 帧解码器绘制现有的 40 卡片场景。Mac 可构建模拟器应用和未签名的真机应用。验证记录区分模拟器 Metal 可用性与实体 iPhone 测试。
